touches.text: The reading: - A plan is three parts. Constraints: the bounds, plus every how Akien is attached to, carried verbatim (encapsulation, the bus as the only channel, ...): a how he states is a constraint. Then outcomes. Then resources. - An outcome is {n, claim, writes_to, reads, after: [n or a ticket id], via?}. The claim is falsifiable, one proof tooth per outcome. The falsifier's clauses merge into the outcomes; there is no separate falsifier list. Old clause n stays outcome n; outcomes made from decisions number after them. via (optional) names the tool or pattern to use, drawn from resources. - Order comes from after: only real dependencies ("can't test the bus envelope shape until the bus works"), which also shape ticket order. Nothing invents them; list order is reading order only. - Resources: pre-existing machines, tools and design patterns, named when they need stating. - The migration is two steps. Mechanical, on every open ticket now: the plan moves to the new field with clause numbers kept, the trail moves whole to the log, by moves to the log. Judgement, when a ticket is next opened for build, never in bulk: each decision becomes an outcome or a constraint, then a coherence check (every step reads as current; a conflict moves to the log or is named). - CC inference: the mechanical step writes each old decision as an outcome numbered after the clauses, carrying its text and no claim; an outcome with no claim is awaiting judgement and holds BUILDME until the judgement step gives it a claim or moves it to constraints. - akienasus_cc_0 - During the change every reader accepts both shapes. Readers are censused first; one sibling ticket per reader component (RULE 1). - The cast door refuses an outcome with no falsifiable claim, and a plan of more than about 7 outcomes, naming children; each refusal is recorded so the ceiling can be tuned (the 7 is CC's guess). - The [?] markers go. - Tickets: aa3e9a70db47 is the migration (rehearsal); d421051bc1f7 is the hand-built worked example; each reader component has its sibling. - akiendelllinux_orchestrator -amm
